Applies knowledge about curriculum, requirements and educational activities to coordinate professional health education programs. Plan, coordinate, and manage all departmental events, including educational programs, conferences, meetings, recognition events, and other special events. Oversee all aspects of event planning and execution, including logistics, scheduling, venue coordination, vendor management, registration, communications, materials preparation, budget tracking, and post-event evaluation to ensure successful outcomes and a positive participant experience.

Under the general supervision of the Operations Administrator, the Education and Community Programs Manager serves as the primary resource for the Department of Urology's Education Division and its staff. The incumbent partners with program directors, faculty, and education coordinators in the management, administration, and strategic direction of residency, fellowship, medical student, CME, and other educational programs. Major responsibilities include coordinating educational activities, supporting incoming and current learners, maintaining curriculum and educational resources, ensuring compliance with accreditation and regulatory standards, supervising education staff, and overseeing the day-to-day operations of the department's education programs.

The Education Manager applies advanced knowledge of medical education principles, accreditation requirements, and curriculum administration to coordinate professional health education programs. Responsibilities include managing teaching and learning activities, curriculum development and implementation, learner scheduling, maintaining education databases, monitoring learner compliance, supporting accreditation activities, and implementing process improvements to ensure operational excellence.

In addition, the Education Manager provides oversight for departmental community programs and outreach initiatives, including the planning, implementation, and evaluation of community education events, health awareness campaigns, patient education programs, and strategic partnerships. The incumbent coordinates logistics, budgets, communications, marketing, stakeholder engagement, and program assessment to ensure successful delivery of outreach activities that support the department's mission and strategic goals.
